planets.name: HD 39091 b
planets.description: Planet of HD 39091 found by radial velocity, with a 2090-day year, found in 2001.

text.card: HD 39091 b was found in 2001 by Anglo-Australian Telescope by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 39091. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Damasso et al. 2020's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.

quotes.title: Pi Mensae b
quotes.card: Pi Mensae b, also known as HD 39091 b, is an extrasolar planet approximately 60 light-years away in the constellation of Mensa.
quotes.introduction: The planet was announced orbiting the yellow main-sequence star Pi Mensae in October 2001.
